server.scope: All server/src/**/*.ts, including routers, app/config/main composition; generated Prisma dependencies, test and declaration files excluded.

client.scope: All client/src/**/*.{ts,tsx}; startup instrumentation imported normally from test setup and measured.

shared.scope: All packages/shared/src/**/*.ts, including versioned generated settings contracts; tests/declarations excluded.

excludedRuns: Initial expanded server run: 2300 passed/four existing skips and one failed existing audit-position assertion; tied frozen timestamps selected creation v1 instead of update v2. Test now identifies the exact update action/entity. No measurement accepted from that run.

First focused retry: Docker engine and preview listeners unavailable before database readiness; all 24 cases skipped. Only runtime socket directories moved to new recoverable quarantines. Original database volume, containers, settings and both earlier recovery backups preserved.
Initial client measurement omitted CSP startup instrumentation as a Vitest setup file. Fresh full-scope client coverage includes it and preserves jitless startup behaviour.
effects: Only the dedicated spoh2027_test database is used by guarded integration helpers. No real local spoh2027 reset/seed/migration, staging fixture or cloud configuration write occurs in coverage verification.
limitations: Coverage floors implement a bounded application-package ratchet. G5 target observations are not programme readiness or closure; access-policy coverage awaits its P11 package and broader P08.9 criteria remain open. CI execution is recorded only after the new workflow passes.
